dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Michael, do you know what? I just bought a new chess set, but the chi phí was too expensive. I saved up for a whole month to buy it.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Oh, cờ vua? I thích playing cờ vua too. The chi phí for this hobby isn't cheap, but it's worth it. Since when has Mira played cờ vua?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Since I was little. In Russia, cờ vua is a popular intellectual sport. But in Vietnam, it's hard to find people to play with. Books about cờ vua are also expensive, the import chi phí is very high.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I could play with Mira. I'm not very good, but I thích learning. Perhaps we could meet at a café this weekend? I'll cover the chi phí for drinks.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Really? You... want to play cờ vua with me? I didn't think you thích traditional things like that. Well... okay, but I'll pay for my own drinks. You don't need to worry about any chi phí.
